en.title: Three different questions
en.subtitle: A practical way to think about the video
items: What was I hoping to understand?
What would establish a health claim?
en.caption: A personal intention and a medical conclusion need different kinds of support.
en.alt: Three different questions. Intention: What was I hoping to understand?. Experience: What did I actually notice?. Evidence: What would establish a health claim?.

en.title: Do not collapse these into one claim
en.subtitle: A practical way to think about the video
items: A treatment needs evidence of benefit and harm.
en.caption: The first statement does not establish the second or third.
en.alt: Do not collapse these into one claim. Feeling: I report energy and clarity. Mechanism: A cellular process needs measurement. Outcome: A treatment needs evidence of benefit and harm.

en.title: Pain does not verify the explanation
en.subtitle: A practical way to think about the video
items: I connect it with cellular repair.
There is no test establishing that connection.
en.caption: The cause is unknown. A symptom should not be treated as evidence of progress.
en.alt: Pain does not verify the explanation. Observed: I report lower-back pain. Assumed: I connect it with cellular repair. Missing: There is no test establishing that connection.
en.foot: Editorial guide, not a measured outcome.

Nuk ka test që e vërteton atë lidhje.

en.title: Three claims, three evidence gaps
en.subtitle: A practical way to think about the video
items: A scale cannot isolate fat change.
Appearance does not establish clinical benefit.
en.caption: No numerical weight-loss chart is justified by this clip.
en.alt: Three claims, three evidence gaps. A guess: No completed weigh-in is shown. Total weight: A scale cannot isolate fat change. Health: Appearance does not establish clinical benefit.
en.foot: Editorial guide, not a measured outcome.
